experimental_design: PF4 stimulated a concentration-dependent increase in tyrosine phosphorylation of a prominent doublet at 95 kDa (Figure 1Bi, arrows). Analysis by mass spectrometry revealed the presence of a signal transducer and activator of transcription (STAT) 5a/b peptide
factor_value: PF4 stimulated a concentration-dependent increase in tyrosine phosphorylation
